boundary: Prospectively registered OpenAlex S6 title/abstract query control for lifecycle, coordination, orchestration, team-capacity, and delivery-flow evidence in AI-assisted software delivery. Developmental only; not a frozen search, eligibility decision, systematic corpus, or PRISMA input.

queries.query: ("large language model" OR LLM OR ChatGPT OR "generative AI" OR "AI-assisted" OR "AI-augmented" OR "AI coding agent") AND ("software delivery" OR "software development" OR "software engineering" OR SDLC) AND (team OR organization OR enterprise OR lifecycle OR workflow OR process OR orchestration OR coordination OR capacity OR flow OR readiness)

sentinels.title: Orchestrating Human-AI Software Delivery: A Retrospective Longitudinal Field Study of Three Software Modernization Programs
sentinels.rationale: Longitudinal industrial evidence across coordinated human-AI analysis, planning, implementation, and validation stages, with delivery and validation outcomes.

sentinels.title: Agile V: A Compliance-Ready Framework for AI-Augmented Engineering -- From Concept to Audit-Ready Delivery
sentinels.rationale: Lifecycle-spanning requirements, design, build, test, compliance, and human-approval workflow with explicit delivery and interaction measures.

sentinels.title: LLMs' Reshaping of People, Processes, Products, and Society in Software Development: A Comprehensive Exploration with Early Adopters
sentinels.rationale: Practitioner evidence reports a productivity-quality paradox, shifted evaluation/integration effort, and limited influence in collaborative lifecycle work.

sentinels.title: Why you shouldn't fully trust ChatGPT: A synthesis of this AI tool's error rates across disciplines and the software engineering lifecycle
sentinels.rationale: Lifecycle synthesis reports material and phase-dependent error rates, constraining unqualified delivery-acceleration claims.

sentinels.title: Agentic Self-Healing for Data and AI Pipelines: An Affordable Vendor-Agnostic Architecture using Open-Source Software
sentinels.rationale: Operations architecture for data and AI pipelines is outside human/team evidence on AI-assisted software delivery and is a precision warning.
